quantity: (A_V/A_K) implied by this law's own tabulated curve, i.e. chi(v_wavelength_um) / chi(ks_wavelength_um) under linear interpolation of the (wave_um, opacity_cm2_per_g) columns in whitney.r550.par
interpolation: linear in wavelength (numpy.interp) on the curve sorted ascending by wave_um -- matches sedfitter's own Extinction.get_av convention exactly (see sed_fit/docs/sedfitter_behavior.md, Q4 ANSWER/RECEIPTS: k(i) = chi(lambda_i)/chi(0.55um), np.interp, left=0., right=0.)
info_scalar_source: whitney.r550.info, AV_over_AK line -- a published summary scalar from the law's original source, not derived from this package's tabulated curve
ruling: owner ruling 2026-08-18 (SESNA task: canonicalize A_K/A_V per extinction law as the curve-internal value): av_over_ak_curve is THE canonical project value -- computed and stored here, alongside the law, so that kappa_Ks = k_Ks/k_Ks == 1 holds exactly and no law-dependent skew enters any a-vs-A_s comparison. The .info AV_over_AK scalar above is retained for provenance/comparison only and must not be used in any dimming computation.
